nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; set in constructor from msg.sender and updated on ownership claim.
Address proposed as the next owner; set by proposeOwner and consumed by claimOwnership.
Mapping of account balances; mutated in _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender allowances; mutated in _approve.
Total token supply; incremented by _mint and decremented by _burn.
Token name set in the ERC20 constructor.
Token symbol set in the ERC20 constructor.
Minimum supply threshold below which burning stops; owner-controlled via setMinSupply.
Recipient of transfer fees; owner-controlled via setBeneficiary.
Flag enabling fee/burn logic on transfers; owner-controlled via setFeesEnabled.
Mapping of accounts exempt from fee collection; owner-controlled via setExcludeFromFee.
Sets owner to msg.sender and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Owner-only function that proposes a new owner address.
Allows the proposed owner to claim ownership; writes owner state.
Returns msg.sender, used as the source of caller identity in ERC20 functions.
Initializes token name and symbol.
Transfers tokens from the caller to a recipient via _transfer.
Transfers tokens using allowance mechanism; calls _transfer and _approve.
Sets allowance for a spender from the caller.
Core balance movement logic; mutates _balances and checks sender balance.
Creates tokens, increasing _totalSupply and recipient balance.
Destroys tokens, decreasing balance and _totalSupply.
Writes allowance values into _allowances mapping.
Increases spender allowance by an added value.
Decreases spender allowance by a subtracted value.
Initializes supply, sets beneficiary, excludes fee accounts and mints total supply.
Overrides ERC20 transfer to apply fee, burn and beneficiary logic with arithmetic on amounts.
Pure arithmetic helper computing a proportional fee from amount and fee basis points.
Burns caller balance and enforces the minimum supply invariant.
Owner-only setter for the minimum supply threshold.
Owner-only setter for the fee beneficiary; also excludes it from fees.
Owner-only toggle enabling or disabling fee collection.
Owner-only function that adds or removes an account from fee exemption.
Modifier enforcing that msg.sender equals owner; access-control gate for privileged functions.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, minting target, exclusion and beneficiary assignment.
Ownership state write gated only by equality with proposedOwner; sensitive access-control path.
Arithmetic combining amount, transferFee and burnedFee in FlokiMother._transfer, including burn trigger when supply-threshold holds.
Multiplication and division of user-supplied amount by a fee basis in calculateFee.
Balance subtraction in ERC20._transfer mutating sender and recipient balances.
Total supply and balance subtraction in ERC20._burn.
Total supply and balance addition in ERC20._mint.
New owner address argument of Owned.proposeOwner.
Sender address argument of FlokiMother._transfer.
Recipient address argument of FlokiMother._transfer.
Token amount argument of FlokiMother._transfer used in fee arithmetic.
Local burned fee value computed in FlokiMother._transfer.
Local transfer fee value computed in FlokiMother._transfer.
Amount argument of FlokiMother.calculateFee.
Fee basis argument of FlokiMother.calculateFee.
Amount argument of FlokiMother.burn.
New minimum supply argument of setMinSupply.
New beneficiary argument of setBeneficiary.
Account argument of setExcludeFromFee.
Exclusion flag argument of setExcludeFromFee.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender (via _msgSender) is passed as the mint recipient in the FlokiMother constructor.
msg.sender is marked as excluded from fee in the constructor.
msg.sender is assigned as the initial beneficiary.
_msgSender returns the tainted msg.sender value.
_msgSender supplies the sender to ERC20.transfer.
_msgSender supplies the owner to ERC20.approve.
_msgSender supplies the spender to ERC20.transferFrom.
The transfer amount is fed into calculateFee for fee computation.
The _amount argument flows into the multiplication/division arithmetic of calculateFee.
calculateFee result is stored as burnedFee.
calculateFee result is stored as transferFee.
minSupply is read to decide whether burning is performed.
_totalSupply is read against minSupply during transfer.
feesEnabled gates the fee logic in _transfer.
isExcludedFromFee controls whether fee logic executes.
beneficiary receives the transfer fee inside _transfer.
burnedFee participates in the final amount arithmetic in _transfer.
transferFee participates in the final amount arithmetic in _transfer.
_balances is read and written in ERC20._transfer.
_totalSupply is decremented in ERC20._burn.
_totalSupply is incremented in ERC20._mint.
_allowances is written in ERC20._approve.
onlyOwner modifier guards proposeOwner.
onlyOwner modifier guards setMinSupply.
onlyOwner modifier guards setBeneficiary.
onlyOwner modifier guards setFeesEnabled.
onlyOwner modifier guards setExcludeFromFee.
setBeneficiary internally calls setExcludeFromFee for the new beneficiary.
claimOwnership writes the owner state variable after checking msg.sender equals proposedOwner.
FlokiMother._transfer calls _burn to destroy the burned fee.
ERC20.transfer delegates to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
FlokiMother constructor calls _mint for the initial supply.
FlokiMother constructor invokes the ERC20 constructor.
FlokiMother constructor invokes the base Owned constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: The proposed owner parameter is only meaningful inside proposeOwner and should be folded into that core function node.
The sender parameter is a direct input of the overridden transfer function.
The recipient parameter is a direct input of the overridden transfer function.
The amount parameter is the primary input driving fee arithmetic in the transfer override.
burnedFee is a temporary computed within _transfer.
transferFee is a temporary computed within _transfer.
The amount parameter feeds the arithmetic of the calculateFee helper.
The fee basis parameter feeds the arithmetic of the calculateFee helper.
The value parameter is the only input of the burn function.
The new minimum supply parameter belongs to the setMinSupply setter.
The new beneficiary parameter belongs to the setBeneficiary setter.
The account parameter belongs to the setExcludeFromFee setter.
The excluded flag parameter belongs to the setExcludeFromFee setter.
